description: The chart illustrates ColEG-R performance (in percent) for two model categories under four fine-tuning conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories “LLaMA-2-13B” and “LLaMA-2-70B” (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “ColEG-R (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 90 with tick marks at 10-point intervals. For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown as a grouped set, with colors/patterns defined by the legend: a light blue bar with diagonal hatch for “no SFT,” a light orange bar with horizontal hatch for “+ SFT on D₀,” a light purple bar with diagonal hatch for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁,” and a solid light pink bar for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂.” For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars are approximately 67% (no SFT), 67% (+ SFT on D₀), 81% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 84% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). For LLaMA-2-70B, the bars are approximately 81% (no SFT), 82% (+ SFT on D₀), 85% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 84% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). The bars are not presented as a sorted ranking; they appear in a consistent legend-defined order within each group, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with annotations or special outlines beyond the color and hatch patterns.
